topic: VeilBoard — a free Wedding Color Palette Generator that shows a chosen palette applied onto real photos of bridesmaid dresses, groomsmen, a bridal bouquet, and a reception table, and lets you re-assign which color goes on each element.
persona: A 28-year-old woman who just got engaged and is planning her wedding. Heavy Pinterest user, has made mood boards, follows wedding accounts, but is NOT a designer and doesn't know color theory. Budget-aware and a bit skeptical of gimmicky tools.

questions.text: How useful is this for planning your wedding?
How much better is this than Pinterest, Coolors-type swatch generators, or The Knot's palette galleries?
questions.scale: 1-5 (1 = worse, 3 = about the same, 5 = clearly better)

questions.text: How likely are you to share what you make with your bridesmaids / fiancé / florist?
